Game Overview

Garden Funny Animals is a animal game built around guide whimsical animals through a perilous garden to collect nutritious veggies while avoiding tricky traps and mischievous mice. Hone your reflexes in this fast-paced action adventure, unlock charming new characters with beach balls, and strategically use revives to keep your veggie quest alive!
